constraints.description: A Business channel article is not simultaneously marked as Entertainment.
constraints.rationale: The retained data-channel indicators are mutually exclusive; an active Business indicator requires the Entertainment indicator to be zero.

constraints.description: A Business channel article is not simultaneously marked as Lifestyle.
constraints.rationale: The retained data-channel indicators are mutually exclusive; an active Business indicator requires the Lifestyle indicator to be zero.

constraints.description: An Entertainment channel article is not simultaneously marked as Lifestyle.
constraints.rationale: The six retained data-channel indicators are mutually exclusive; when the Entertainment indicator is active, the Lifestyle indicator must be zero.

constraints.description: A Social Media channel article is not simultaneously marked as Lifestyle.
constraints.rationale: The retained data-channel indicators are mutually exclusive; an active Social Media indicator requires the Lifestyle indicator to be zero.

constraints.description: Publication weekday deterministically determines the weekend indicator.
constraints.rationale: The processed schema defines is_weekend as 1 exactly for Saturday or Sunday and 0 for Monday through Friday.

constraints.rationale: The retained data-channel indicators are mutually exclusive; an active World indicator requires the Lifestyle indicator to be zero.
